crossRefs.note: Hear me, Yahweh, hear me, that this people may know that you, Yahweh, are God, and that you have turned their heart…
Turn us again, God. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.
Turn us again, God of Armies. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.
Turn us again, Yahweh God of Armies. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.
Turn us, God of our salvation, and cause your indignation toward us to cease.
“I have surely heard Ephraim grieving thus, ‘You have chastised me, and I was chastised, as an untrained calf. Turn me…
I will give them one heart and one way, that they may fear me forever, for their good, and the good of their children…
I will make an everlasting covenant with them, that I will not turn away from following them, to do them good. I will…
I will give them one heart, and I will put a new spirit within you. I will take the stony heart out of their flesh, and…
that they may walk in my statutes, and keep my ordinances, and do them. They will be my people, and I will be their God.
I will sprinkle clean water on you, and you will be clean. I will cleanse you from all your filthiness, and from all…
“ ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “For this, moreover, I will be inquired of by the house of Israel, to do it for them: I will…
Yahweh, I have heard of your fame. I stand in awe of your deeds, Yahweh. Renew your work in the middle of the years. In…
I will build you again, and you will be built, O virgin of Israel. You will again be adorned with your tambourines, and…
Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, says: “Yet again they will use this speech in the land of Judah and in its cities…
Yahweh says: “Yet again there will be heard in this place, about which you say, ‘It is waste, without man and without…
In the cities of the hill country, in the cities of the lowland, in the cities of the South, in the land of Benjamin…
Yahweh says: “I have returned to Zion, and will dwell in the middle of Jerusalem. Jerusalem shall be called ‘The City…
Then the offering of Judah and Jerusalem will be pleasant to Yahweh, as in the days of old, and as in ancient years.

translations.web: Turn us to yourself, Yahweh, and we will be turned. Renew our days as of old.
translations.bsb: Restore us to Yourself, O LORD, so we may return; renew our days as of old,
translations.kjv: Turn thou us unto thee, O LORD, and we shall be turned; renew our days as of old.
translations.asv: Turn thou us unto thee, O Jehovah, and we shall be turned; Renew our days as of old.
